# Scene

Runs a `scene.*`, `script.*`, `button.*`, `input_button.*` or `lock.*` **action** from a compact tile.

<div class="widget-previews">
<figure><a href="../img/gallery/scene_glow.png"><img src="../img/gallery/scene_glow.png" alt="Scene, Glow style" loading="lazy" width="180" height="90" style="width: 144px"></a></figure>
</div>

## Entities

| Entity | Domains |
| --- | --- |
| Action | `scene.*`, `script.*`, `button.*`, `input_button.*`, `lock.*` |

## Requirements

None beyond the entities.

## Options

No options beyond the entities; the controls follow what the entity supports.

## On the panel

- A tap runs the action directly, without a popup.

## Size

- Minimum: **160 × 70 px**.
- Maximum: **dashboard width × 160 px**, capped by the display's dashboard area.

The minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size. [Choose your display](../choose-display.md) lists the dashboard geometry; [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains spacing and touch targets.
